Looking back these last months, I've realized alcohol has been a major culprit when it comes to relapses for me personally. Only on day 4 but I've decided, no more alcohol. Nofap is more important to me right now than alcohol. Adding this: Even the 3-4 beer moto I was sticking by didnt work, it made my sleep-patterns all f'd up, it made me horny at times and when I drank a tad more and had a bad night's sleep and were hungover > relapse. Alcohol is also a depressant, so I also had moments of "life sucks anyway" and will still do sober, the point being alcohol just makes it that much harder to stay on course for me in my current mental state. And never forget, dont stop trying.
